failure_patterns.pattern: answer_format: Answers used a name form at the wrong scope, either adding components or omitting part of the expected designation.

rejected_edits.content: For people, match the name form required by the answer slot, rather than automatically choosing the longest form found in context. Give the full identity when asked to identify who; give only the requested surname, familiar name, title, or form of address when the clue asks for that element. Retain components needed for the requested conventional name, but do not append unasked names or titles merely because context supplies them.
rejected_edits.target: For people, use the full identity supported by substantive context; do not answer with only a surname merely because a clue echo abbreviates it. Preserve initials, titles, and other name elements when the clue or a reliable passage supplies them—do not strip them for stylistic normalization.
